text:
LADY MACBETH:
  Donalbain.
MACBETH:
  This is a miserable sight.
  (He looks at his hands.)
LADY MACBETH:
  That's a stupid thing to say, "a miserable sight."
MACBETH:
  One of them laughed in his sleep, and one cried out, "Murder!"
  They woke each other up. I stood there and listened to them.
  But they just said their prayers, and settled down to sleep again.
LADY MACBETH:
  There are two of them sleeping in that room.
MACBETH:
  One cried, "God bless us!" and the other said, "Amen,"
  as if they'd seen me standing there with these butcher's hands.
  I listened to how scared they were, and I couldn't say "Amen"
  when they said, "God bless us."
